events.title: October 22 patch notes
events.summary: AUTOMATE DEATH demo: update The demo now starts on Mac On some Macs the demo wouldn't open at all ("The game couldn't start a process"). macOS now accepts it, and it runs on Apple Silicon Macs as well as Intel ones. If Steam's services can't be loaded, the game now carries on without them instead of failing to start. events.title: October 21 patch notes
events.summary: New scoringRuns are now scored out of 1,000,000 points:Clear: 400,000. Any clear outranks any loss.Protection: up to 200,000. You lose points as your base takes damage.Speed: up to 200,000 for clearing the field quickly after the last hostile arrives. It halves at 10 seconds.Assets: up to 200,000. events.title: Rolling bug fixes being deployed
events.summary: Hey everyone. Over the next 12 hours there will be many small, targeted updates aimed at addressing the various issues that have been identified and reported, examples including crashing, freezing, unintuitive UI experiences, and so on. These patches will be small (around 10mb each). I invite you to share you experiences in this thread or on Discord. Be brutally honest and clear. I want to make a great game, so your feedback is essential. The demo is the perfect cornerstone for yourselves and us
